body: The migration touches three subsystems. How should it be sequenced?
choices: Migrate the schema first and leave both application versions reading through the compatibility view until the backfill finishes
Ship the application change first behind a flag, then migrate the schema once every instance is reporting the new version
Do both in one window and accept the downtime, which is the only option that never has two schema versions live at once
descriptions: Shortest schema window, needs a flag
Simplest to reason about, needs downtime
